title: Schistosoma haematobium larva FTA-to-WGS
author: Tom Pennance
materials: Beckman Coulter Agencourt AMPure XP beads

This protocol is as described by the invitrogen Qubit dsDNA BR Assay Kit User Guide: Prepare the Qubit working solution by diluting the Qubit dsDNA BR Reagent 1:200 in Qubit dsDNA BR Buffer (e.g. for 10 samples, add 10 µl of Qubit dsDNA BR Reagent to 1,990 µl of Qubit dsDNA BR Buffer and mix. Add 190 µl of Qubit working solution to each 0.5 ml assay tube (StarLab 0.5 ml PCR Tube, Flat Cap, Natural cat no. I1405-8100). Add 10 µl of the 100 fold diluted purified WGA product to each assay tube and vortex for 3-5 seconds. Read assay tube concentration on Qubit and back calculate WGA concentration by multiplying by 100.

The starting material for the standard curve generation was a Schistosoma haematobium adult worm obtained from the Schistosomiasis Collection at the Natural History Museum, the DNA of which was extracted using the Qiagen Blood and Tissue kit following manufacturers instructions, and DNA eluted in 50 µl of ultra pure water.

Recommendation is to continue directly to the next step (Adapter Ligation), though if necessary, samples can be stored at -20ºC overnight although a loss of yield may be observed (~20% reported by NEB)

Adapter Ligation Note: Prior to starting, ensure that the following components are thawed on ice: NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix NEBNext Ligation Enhancer NEBNext Adaptor for Illumina NEB USER Enzyme (comes with the NEBNext Multiplex Oligos for Illumina 96 Unique Dual Index Primer Pairs Sets)
Once incubation complete, remove from thermal cycler and immediately add 3 µl of the NEB USER Enzyme to the ligation mixture

steps.title: Prepare Miracidia from Urine Samples
steps.instruction: Isolate schistosome miracidia from patient urine samples.

substeps.instruction: Collect urine in 50 ml individual sample pots, store in a cooler/fridge in the dark.
Homogenize positive urine samples by vigorous mixing or using a 10ml urine filtration syringe.
Push all homogenized urine through a SEFAR Nitex 03-25/19, 20 micron 13 mm stamped disk filter housed in a Swinnex filter holder.
Remove the filter with clean forceps and place it in a labeled petri dish with bottled or deionized water.
Place the petri dish in a warm environment in indirect sunlight or under a lamp to stimulate hatching; check for motile miracidia using a dissection microscope.

steps.title: Capture Miracidia on FTA Cards
steps.instruction: Transfer individual miracidia to FTA cards for DNA capture.

substeps.instruction: Use a dissection microscope and a p20 pipette to capture individual miracidia in 3 µl of liquid.
Pipette the 3 µl directly onto a labeled FTA card, ensuring space between spots.
Dry FTA cards overnight (or at least a few hours) away from direct sunlight, propping the pink capture side up.
Fold the protective cover, seal in a plastic bag, and store in a cool, dark, sealed container.

steps.title: Extract DNA from FTA Card
steps.instruction: Release DNA from the FTA card punch through a series of washes.

substeps.instruction: Punch a 2 mm spot containing a miracidium using a UniCore Punch 2.0 mm and transfer to a labeled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 180 µl of QIAcard FTA wash buffer using a p200 pipette and filtered tip; vortex briefly and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature on a mixer (low rpm) or rocking platform.
Remove and discard the wash buffer and tip using an unfiltered p200 tip (set to 200), minimizing contact with the punch.
Repeat the wash and removal step (increase to 2-3 times if sample quality is substandard).
Add 180 µl of TE-1 buffer using a p200 pipette and filtered tip; vortex briefly and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature on a mixer or rocking platform.
Remove and discard TE-1 buffer and tip using an unfiltered p200 tip (set to 200). On the second removal, gently place the punch on the side of the tube to aid drying.
Repeat the TE-1 wash and removal step (increase to 2-3 times if necessary).
Dry punches until damp (do not overdry) in the tubes with lids open at 50°C for 5-10 minutes in a dry bath/heat block.

Transfer the slightly damp punch to a 0.2 mL PCR tube using fine tweezers (clean tweezers between samples with 70% ethanol and lint-free tissue; optionally use microbead heat sterilizer or 10% bleach).

steps.title: Whole Genome Amplification (WGA)
steps.instruction: Amplify the DNA using the Cytiva Ready-To-Go GenomiPhi V3 kit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare denaturation buffer by mixing 10 µl ultra pure water and 10 µl GenomiPhi denaturation buffer per sample.
Add 20 µl of the denaturation buffer to the 0.2 mL tube containing the FTA punch and centrifuge briefly to submerge the punch.
Heat the tube to 95°C for 3 minutes in a pre-heated thermal cycler (no cooling step).
Immediately move the tube to wet ice to avoid renaturation.
While on ice, remove 20 µl of denatured buffer and transfer it to a Cytiva Ready-To-Go GenomiPhi V3 WGA tube containing the enzymatic cake.
Seal with supplied caps and wait 5-10 minutes for the cake to dissolve, using intermittent finger flicks or gentle vortexing while keeping cool.
Spin down the dissolved cake briefly (2 seconds at 1,000 xg in a plate centrifuge).
Transfer 20 µl of the dissolved enzyme cake liquid back to the tube containing the FTA punch and spin down briefly.
Incubate in a PCR machine: 30°C for 120 minutes, 65°C for 10 minutes, and a 4°C hold.

steps.title: Purify WGA Product
steps.instruction: Clean the WGA product using AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 20 µl of WGA product liquid (leaving behind the FTA punch) to a 0.2 mL PCR strip containing 36 µl of room temperature AMPure XP beads.
Vortex the beads to resuspend and make homogenous.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on a 0.2 mL magnetic rack for 2 minutes until the solution clears.
Set p100/p200 to >56 µl and remove/discard the supernatant (do not touch the beads).
Add 180 µl of freshly made 70% ethanol; incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Remove ethanol (set to 200 µl). Repeat this wash once more (total of two washes). Use a p10 to remove remaining ethanol from sides/bottom.
Proceed immediately to the next step (do not let beads sit without ethanol for >2 minutes).
Add 31 µl Molecular Biology Grade water and gently vortex or pipette mix (set to 20 µl) until the bead pellet disappears.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on a magnetic rack for 1 minute until the solution clears.
Transfer 30 µl of eluate to a new tube without disturbing the pellet.
Store remaining ~28 µl of purified WGA product at -20°C.

steps.title: Quantify Genome Copy Number via qPCR
steps.instruction: Determine the S. haematobium genome copy number using a standard curve and qPCR.

substeps.instruction: Make a 100-fold dilution of the purified WGA product: add 2 µl product to 198 µl ultra pure water.

Generate a standard curve (if not already done) using S. haematobium adult worm DNA and Sh α2 primers (Forward: 5′-GGTGGTACTGGTTCTGGTTT-3′, Reverse: 5′-AAAGCACAATCCGAATGTTCTAA-3′) with Cytiva PuReTaq Ready-To-Go PCR beads.
Perform PCR cycling: 95°C 5min (1x), 95°C 30s/60°C 30s/72°C 30s (35x), 72°C 10min (1x), 4°C hold.
Bead-clean the PCR product using 45 µl (1.8x) AMPure XP beads, two 180 µl 70% ethanol washes, and elute in 30 µl water.
Quantify PCR product via QuBit DS DNA Broad Range (3 replicates) and create a serial dilution (S1: 1 part product to 39 parts water; S2-S7: 10-fold dilutions).
Run standard curve qPCR on QuantStudio 6 Pro (Reaction volume 10 µl, Heated cover 105°C) and determine slope and Y-intercept.
Set up sample qPCR: 5 µl SYBR Green Universal Master Mix, 3.4 µl water, 0.3 µl each of Sh α2 forward and reverse primers. Add 1 µl of the 100-fold diluted WGA product.
Run qPCR and analyze data: calculate genome copy number using formula =10^((Cq - Y-intercept) / slope) and multiply by 100.

steps.title: Library Preparation (NEBNext Ultra II FS)
steps.instruction: Prepare sequencing libraries from the purified WGA product.

substeps.instruction: Select samples with the highest Sh copies/ng (WGA genome copy number / QuBit concentration).
Normalize 100-200 ng of purified WGA product into a total volume of 26 µl using ultra pure water.
Thaw Ultra II FS Reaction Buffer (vortex if precipitate is present) and Ultra II FS Enzyme Mix (vortex 5-8 seconds) on ice.
Add components to a 0.2 mL thin wall PCR tube on ice, vortex for 5 seconds, and spin briefly.
Run thermal cycler (lid 75°C): 37°C for 20 minutes, 65°C for 30 minutes, 4°C hold.
Add Ligation Master Mix, Ligation Enhancer, and Adaptor for Illumina. Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times with a 50 µl setting and spin briefly.
Incubate at 20°C for 15 minutes (lid off), then mix again and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes (lid 47°C).

steps.title: Size Selection and Bead Cleaning
steps.instruction: Perform double-sided size selection to target library sizes of 320-470 bp.

substeps.instruction: Bring reaction volume to 100 µl by adding 28.5 µl 0.1X TE.
Add 30 µl (~0.3X) resuspended AMPure XP beads, vortex 3-5 seconds, centrifuge briefly, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes; transfer the supernatant (~130 µl) to a new 0.2 mL tube and discard the beads.
Add 15 µl (~0.15X) resuspended AMPure XP beads to the supernatant, vortex 3-5 seconds, centrifuge briefly, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes; discard the supernatant and keep the beads.
Wash beads twice with 180 µl freshly prepared 80% ethanol (30 seconds each), removing all liquid after the second wash.
Air dry beads on the magnetic stand for up to 5 minutes (until glossy brown, not cracked).
Elute DNA into 17 µl 0.1X TE, vortex, and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes and transfer 15 µl of eluate to a new tube or directly to PCR enrichment.

steps.title: PCR Enrichment and Final Library QC
steps.instruction: Amplify the adapter-ligated DNA and perform final quality control.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge NEBNext Indexes plate (280 x g for 1 min).
In a new 0.2 mL PCR tube, combine 25 µl Q5 master mix, 10 µl primer index, and the adapter-ligated DNA.
Seal, vortex/pipette mix, and centrifuge briefly.
Run PCR enrichment in a thermal cycler (lid 105°C).
Clean the PCR reaction by adding 45 µl (0.9X) resuspended AMPure XP beads, vortexing, and centrifuging briefly.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes; transfer 30 µl of the final library to a new 0.2 mL tube and store at -20°C.
Clean the remaining library: resuspend beads in 33 µl 0.1X TE, vortex, and incubate for 2 minutes.
Perform two washes with 200 µl 80% ethanol, air dry for up to 5 minutes, and elute.
Assess size distribution using Agilent D1000 ScreenTape (ideal range 350-450 bp) and concentration using QuBit DNA BR Assay.
Pool libraries in equal molar concentrations using the formula: nM library = (QuBit conc ng/µL * 10^6 / 660) / TapeStation fragment size.
Store pooled libraries at -20°C.
